colorRoles.note: The live docs force a .light class; :root there resolves to the dark adaptive values, which is how the dark column of the palette was read. Component dark rendering is inferred from those adaptive pairs (not seen live), plus three derived dark tweaks: floating shadows turn black, the dark button label follows --surface-base, the highlight mask stays static.
colorRoles.darkPolicy: Apps in Toss does not support dark mode (FAQ, design FAQ, non-game release checklist). The dark column is unofficial reference data.
